title: LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial fraud detection increasingly relies on heterogeneous transaction graphs, in which entities such as cards and merchants play distinct business roles and the risk meaning of an attribute depends on the entity's role: a high transaction volume may be routine for a merchant but unusual for a card. Heterogeneous graph neural networks preserve typed entities and relations but typically treat these attributes as role-agnostic inputs and leave their business meaning implicit. Meanwhile, most existing methods integrating large language models (LLMs) with graphs focus on homogeneous graphs or heterogeneous graphs with naturally available textual attributes, leaving their use on transaction graphs with structured attributes underexplored. translated_title: 基于业务语义的LLM增强异构图学习用于金融欺诈检测
translated_abstract: 金融欺诈检测日益依赖于异构交易图，其中卡片和商户等实体扮演着不同的业务角色，属性的风险含义取决于实体所扮演的角色：例如高交易量对商户来说可能是常规情况，但对卡片而言则属异常。异构图神经网络能够保留类型化的实体和关系，但通常将这些属性视为与角色无关的输入，使其业务含义保持隐式。同时，大多数将大语言模型（LLM）与图结合的现有方法主要聚焦于同构图或具有天然可用的文本属性的异构图，而LLM在具有结构化属性的交易图上的应用尚未得到充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SemHGT，这是一个LLM增强的框架，它根据实体角色来解释结构化属性，并通过三个阶段将业务语义显式化：(1) 角色感知……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SemHGT框架，利用大语言模型根据实体角色解释交易图中结构化属性的业务语义，将其显式化以提升金融欺诈检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes SemHGT, an LLM-enhanced framework that interprets structured attributes according to entity roles and makes business semantics explicit in heterogeneous transaction graphs, improving financial fraud detection.
